2090. Computing the Factorial of a Fixed Number

50

Medium

Problem Statement
Compute and print the factorial of 5 by directly multiplying the numbers from 1 to 5 together.

Description
The factorial of 5, written 5!, is the product of all integers from 1 to 5. Using variables to hold intermediate products, directly compute the factorial by multiplying step by step (1, then by 2, then by 3, and so on) and print the final result. No loop is required since the number of multiplications is fixed.
